evidence.title: Jérôme d'Ambrosio
evidence.text: Jérôme d'Ambrosio (born 27 December 1985) is a Belgian professional racing driver.

evidence.title: Jérôme d'Ambrosio
evidence.text: He drove for Marussia Virgin Racing during the 2011 Formula One World Championship.

evidence.title: Jérôme d'Ambrosio
evidence.text: As a result of the one-race ban given to Romain Grosjean for actions at the start of the 2012 Belgian Grand Prix, d'Ambrosio replaced the Frenchman for the 2012 Italian Grand Prix.

evidence.title: Jérôme d'Ambrosio
evidence.text: In 2016, he is competing in Formula E driving for Dragon Racing.

evidence.title: Jérôme d'Ambrosio
evidence.text: D'Ambrosio achieved his first Formula E victory in 2015 at the 2015 Berlin ePrix, and a second at the 2016 Mexican ePrix, both as a result of Lucas di Grassi's disqualification.

evidence.title: Sébastien Buemi
evidence.text: Sébastien Olivier Buemi (born 31 October 1988) is a Swiss professional racing driver, who formerly competed for Scuderia Toro Rosso in Formula One.

evidence.title: Sébastien Buemi
evidence.text: Buemi is currently a reserve driver for Scuderia Toro Rosso's sister team, Red Bull Racing, as well as being a member of Toyota's FIA World Endurance Championship squad and e.dams Renault in the FIA Formula E Championship.

evidence.title: Sébastien Buemi
evidence.text: Along with teammate Anthony Davidson, Buemi became World Champion in the LMP1 class of the FIA World Endurance Championship, in 2014.

evidence.title: Sébastien Buemi
evidence.text: He won the second ever Formula E championship, the season held across 2015–2016, by two points for setting the fastest lap time in the final race despite not finishing the event.

evidence.title: Lucas di Grassi
evidence.text: Lucas Tucci di Grassi (born 11 August 1984) is a Brazilian professional racing driver who currently competes for Audi Sport ABT in Formula E and is the 2016-17 World Champion.

evidence.title: Lucas di Grassi
evidence.text: In 2014, di Grassi became the first driver in motorsport history to win a motor race in an all-electric single-seater racing car at the 2014 Beijing ePrix.

evidence.title: Lucas di Grassi
evidence.text: He was also runner-up in the 2007 GP2 Series, 2015-16 FIA Formula E and 2016 FIA World Endurance Championship, and drove for Virgin Racing in the 2010 Formula One season.
